description.en: Deinonychus antirrhopus: whole living environment prop. Nominal 0.9m whole length. Flesh, muted umber-gray colour, short feather mantle and arm masses are inferred artistic completion, not direct feather fossil evidence. Arched skull, grasping arms and stiff balancing tail informed by LEFT REAR Yale skeleton, not foreground Poposaurus.
description.zh: Deinonychus风格化完整活体环境道具；软组织、姿态、颜色与名义尺度含艺术解释，并非精确标本。
